expected_behavior: saves the draft to a file, runs voice_check.py with --register email-external, and reports the verdict with the specific findings (length vs the user's band, sign-off class share, banned or AI-default phrases, politeness markers)
does not rewrite the draft; at most points at what would change the verdict
distinguishes FAIL (bans, length, paragraphs, never-seen classes) from WARN (advisory) and mentions the self-test rate if known
